en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing three people in elaborate folk or theatrical costumes, resembling traditional Russian or Slavic dress with large headdresses, patterned garments, and fur trim. They stand close together in the dark, illuminated from the front, and hold a rectangular sheet of paper or placard toward the camera. The text on the sheet appears inverted, as though the original negative was printed backwards.
